gloss: peak earning time, busy season for making money

definitions.gloss: peak earning time, busy season for making money
definitions.explanation: The best time or season to earn money. A period when business is booming or opportunities for profit are greatest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧{業|ぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だ。
examples.english: Summer is the peak earning season for the tourism industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}ろう→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: Now is the time to earn, so let's work hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小売店|こうりてん}→小売店：20689_kouriten⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だ。
examples.english: The bonus season is the biggest moneymaking period for retail stores.

notes:
{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき} combines ⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧ (to earn) + {時|どき} (time/season), meaning the optimal period for making money.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}: the peak earning season for ~
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だ: now is the time to earn
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}: the biggest moneymaking period

SIMILAR 〜{時|どき} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}→書き入れ時：17629_kakiiredoki⟧: busy season for business (similar meaning)
- ⟦{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}→食べ頃：26567_tabegoro⟧: the right time to eat (ripe)
- ⟦{見|み}{頃|ごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧: the best time to see (flowers, etc.)

USAGE:
Used for businesses, industries, and individuals. Can be used literally about seasonal earning opportunities or figuratively to encourage seizing an opportunity. ⟦{書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}→書き入れ時：17629_kakiiredoki⟧ is a near-synonym but focuses more on the business being busy, while {稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき} emphasizes the opportunity to earn.
